commands.command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 755 /etc/inventory
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync >/dev/null <<'INVENTORY_SYNC_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
source_host=10.100.129.10
source_path=/etc/inventory/app.conf
destination_dir=/etc/inventory
destination_path=$destination_dir/app.conf
identity=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519
known_hosts=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_known_hosts

umask 077
tmp=$(mktemp "$destination_dir/.app.conf.sync.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/scp -q -p \
  -i "$identity" \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" \
  -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
  "inventorysync@$source_host:$source_path" "$tmp"

sudo_mode=$(stat -c %a "$tmp")
if test ! -e "$destination_path" || ! cmp -s "$tmp" "$destination_path" || test "$(stat -c %a "$destination_path")" != "$sudo_mode"; then
  chown root:root "$tmp"
  mv -f "$tmp" "$destination_path"
  restorecon -F "$destination_path" 2>/dev/null || true
  trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
  printf 'updated %s sha256=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(sha256sum "$destination_path" | awk '{print $1}')"
else
  printf 'in-sync %s sha256=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(sha256sum "$destination_path" | awk '{print $1}')"
fi
INVENTORY_SYNC_SCRIPT
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
sudo chmod 750 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
printf '%s\n' '*/5 * * * * root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync >> /var/log/inventory-config-sync.log 2>&1' | sudo tee /etc/cron.d/inventory-config-sync >/dev/null
sudo chown root:root /etc/cron.d/inventory-config-sync
sudo chmod 644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-config-sync
sudo tee /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-config-sync >/dev/null <<'INVENTORY_SYNC_LOGROTATE'
/var/log/inventory-config-sync.log {
    weekly
    rotate 8
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0600 root root
}
INVENTORY_SYNC_LOGROTATE
sudo chown root:root /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-config-sync
sudo chmod 644 /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-config-sync
sudo /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
sudo tail -1 /var/log/inventory-config-sync.log 2>/dev/null || true
stat -c 'destination=%n mode=%a owner=%U:%G size=%s' /etc/inventory/app.conf
sha256sum /etc/inventory/app.conf
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-config-sync
